def manage_list(capacity, operations):
    data=[None]*capacity; links=list(range(1,capacity))+[-1];head=-1;free=0;results=[]
    for op,value in operations:
        prev=-1;cur=head
        while cur!=-1 and data[cur]<value:prev,cur=cur,links[cur]
        found=cur!=-1 and data[cur]==value
        if op=='insert':
            if found or free==-1:results.append(False);continue
            slot=free;free=links[slot];data[slot]=value;links[slot]=cur
            if prev==-1:head=slot
            else:links[prev]=slot
            results.append(True)
        else:
            if not found:results.append(False);continue
            if prev==-1:head=links[cur]
            else:links[prev]=links[cur]
            data[cur]=None;links[cur]=free;free=cur;results.append(True)
    values=[];cur=head
    while cur!=-1:values.append(data[cur]);cur=links[cur]
    return [results,values]

Set data to [None] * capacity. Set links to list(range(1, capacity)) + [-1]. Set head to -1. Set free to 0. Set results to an empty list.
Process each (op, value) in operations.
Set prev to -1. Set cur to head.
Repeat while cur differs from -1 and data[cur] is less than value. Set (prev, cur) to (cur, links[cur]).
Set found to cur differs from -1 and data[cur] equals value.
Check whether op equals 'insert'.
Check whether found or free equals -1. Append False to results. Skip to the next loop iteration.
Set slot to free. Set free to links[slot]. Set data[slot] to value. Set links[slot] to cur.
Check whether prev equals -1. Set head to slot.
Set links[prev] to slot.
Append True to results.
Otherwise, take this branch.
Check whether not (found). Append False to results. Skip to the next loop iteration.
Check whether prev equals -1. Set head to links[cur].
Set links[prev] to links[cur].
Set data[cur] to None. Set links[cur] to free. Set free to cur. Append True to results.
Set values to an empty list. Set cur to head.
Repeat while cur differs from -1. Append data[cur] to values. Set cur to links[cur].
Return [results, values].
